items.title: Go Home completion now restores tracking/aiming when auto-tracking is enabled or when tracking was previously active (prevents autotrack from staying off after homing).

Manual control + Go Home: refresh manual override suppression per button press, prevent YOLO/Hybrid auto-tracking from overriding manual/home moves, force threaded YOLO with shorter async max-age, and avoid sync model loads in update_frame.
UI cleanup: removed unused Workspace dock; Behavior Presets dock stays hidden by default and excluded from saved layouts (still available via Widgets menu).
Presets/defaults now persist motion-gate, detection pause, speed optimization, and scope visual settings; scope visual settings window height reduced.
Auto-fire safety: optional motion-verified gate (UI in Tracking Behavior) to prevent firing on stationary targets. Disabled by default; settings persist via motion_fire_* keys.
Speed optimizations: faster serial cadence, faster bus-servo timing, predictive lead, async YOLO, ROI cropping, light-model preference, and optional redundant-command bypass.
Aiming stability: main app now uses SmartTracker (centroid smoothing + persistence) and avoids ROI centroid drift so the yellow-dot stays centered on the tracked object.
Sentry Mode startup fix: re-enabled sentry hooks by default so the Sentry tab receives the live camera feed and can take control when enabled.

Current telemetry + Health Monitor: stop graph flatlining at 0 when telemetry is missing; add explicit 'No telemetry' status and COM-swap warning; added Dual Port Nano IO+telemetry 2026 firmware (STAT I=<mA> on A2); SerialBus Upgrade 2026 firmware now enables total-current telemetry by default (A2).

TRIGGER FIX: Fixed projectile servo not firing in Dual Port mode. Root cause: Arduino single-token parser incorrectly matched packed commands (F1L1R0G0S0M1) as 'F1', ignoring mode token M1. Fix: Python now sends S0/M1 as separate commands before F/L/R/G, ensuring Arduino correctly sets projectile mode before processing fire. Arduino sketch also updated to check line length before treating as single-token.
